_about: Births to and deaths of New York City residents, calendar years 1970-1982. 'dohmh_in_city_resident' = events that occurred in the city to city residents, from the NYC Department of Health annual Summary of Vital Statistics for each year (Table 3 for 1970-75, Table 2 from 1976; health-center-district tables for 1972), read from the scanned reports at https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/data/data-sets/vital-statistics-data-archive.page (files .../vs/1970sum.pdf through 1982sum.pdf); page images in dohmh_1970s/. These exclude residents' births and deaths that occurred outside the city. 'nchs_resident' = full resident counts (including events outside the city) from NCHS, Vital Statistics of the United States; read for every year 1970-1980 from the natality (Table 2-1) and mortality (Table 7-1/8-1) volumes; each value's borough rows and race rows sum exactly to the city figure; crops in nchs_vsus_1970s/.
